attacks.name: Assault Rifle
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

|!wild| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make one additional |*Assault Rifle| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Red Fury
steps: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Away from this character |!range_small|. Then, if the defender was Pushed, immediately make an |*Assault Rifle| attack targeting it.

superPowers.name: Hydra Tactics
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 2 of this character. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character.

superPowers.name: Got Your Back
superPowers.body: If an allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character may make an |*Assault Rifle| attack against the enemy character that caused the effect.

superPowers.name: Rogue Agent
superPowers.body: One character with |*Rogue Agent| counts as an affiliated character during Squad building.

superPowers.name: Spetsnaz Training
superPowers.body: This character may reroll one die when either attacking or being attacked by a character that is within |!range| 1.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Healthy side.
"Red Fury" can only Push characters Size 3 or less.
The "Rapid Fire" special rule from "Assault Rifle" now triggers on |!wild| instead of |!hit|.
Rapid Fire special rule added to Assault Rifle.
Got Your Back's Power Cost increased from 2 to 3.
